_doc: VANI persona hierarchy and per-field decision rules. APPROVED v2.0. prior.py and loop2_update.py read the levels and keys from here through scripts/hierarchy.py (no level lists in code); the gates and validator read probe_files, reason_types and hard ranges.

changes.what: Draft. Adds L3-L6 as nested levels (code at a8f2e06 has L0-L2 nested; AOV and zone as flat offsets; state and category group not built). Fields are decided by the agent with a reason type; per-field probe files; no fixed amendment menu.

Per the persona session: probe_files are file#section; added search_terms and evidence_rule per field; added top-level hooks{} with probe_files and search_terms; voice_id needs no reason; empathy is free text with no value groups; I01 is core.md#I01.
L2 band labels (small, medium, medium-high, high); English suggested for 5 Cr+; random draw (top-2 only) and 15% P0 holdout marked DECIDED.

Approved (Rishav via persona session). Added path_key and seed_key per persona level, band map (5 Cr and above grouped), voice_lean_f, brief.min_calls. prior.py and loop2_update.py now read levels and keys from this file (scripts/hierarchy.py).
search_terms tightened (phrases and regex over single words; generic terms dropped); 're:' prefix convention in probe_rules.

holdout.note: DECIDED (persona session's user, 2026-10-10): keep the 15% P0 holdout. P0 is the current production style and the comparison group.

select_rule.script_gives: top-2 personas for the seller's path (scoreboard A) and a brief per field
select_rule.base: the selected persona is the base; every field keeps its value unless a reason type below allows a change
select_rule.randomness: DECIDED (persona session's user, 2026-10-10): the weighted random draw stays ONLY for picking the top-2 personas (it is the propensity for learning). Field values are never drawn.

persona_levels.note: TMW and KCD map to CSD until decided

Seller size by annual turnover: below 40 lakh = small; 40 lakh to 1.5 crore = medium; 1.5 to 5 crore = medium-high; 5 crore and above = high (all bands above 5 Cr grouped). Labels are for the agent and the brief; the key stays the band.

persona_levels.buckets: state name; falls back to its zone
category group name; falls back to division
persona_levels.note: OPEN QUESTION: the seller's top category group (suggested) or the group of the hook's category

fallback: A level with few calls uses its parent's rate: pooled mean = (kappa * parent_mean + successes) / (kappa + n). Counts are kept per field x value group x level.

voice_levels.note: used only to choose the voice; never said on the call
learned key (a fixed lean only at a8f2e06)

seller_evidence.allowed_when: the seller's own files support a value different from the selected persona's
requires: cites with a quote of at most 20 words each (file#id)

hierarchy.allowed_when: the search of the field's probe files found NO seller evidence AND the brief has data for the seller's path
requires: a 'searched' note: what was looked for and not found
hierarchy.if_evidence_existed: the agent must say why the evidence does not apply

start_persona.allowed_when: no seller evidence and no hierarchy data
start_persona.effect: the value stays equal to the selected persona's value; no new value
requires: a 'searched' note (so we know the agent looked)

rules: a field with no reason or a wrong cite fails the validator

calls_probe: 'calls/' means every call file in the last 90 days that INDEX.md lists

voice_gender.looks_for: recorded gender or salutation; a past call where the seller reacted to a woman or man
voice_gender.evidence_rule: a recorded gender or salutation (A07), or a call turn where the seller reacts to the voice or addresses the caller by gender

voice_id.looks_for: derived from voice_gender and language; must be a catalogue voice

pace.looks_for: rushed or slow-speech cues in past calls; languages the seller speaks
pace.evidence_rule: a call turn where the seller was rushed or asked for a callback (faster, briefer) or asked to slow down or repeat (slower)

pitch.looks_for: seller reaction to the voice in past calls
pitch.evidence_rule: a call turn where the seller comments on the voice (loud, soft, hard to hear)

language_start.looks_for: profile city/state, GST state (X06, optional), onboarding cities, languages heard on calls; a suggestion, with a backup language and a note when the profile and GST states differ
language_start.rule: a SUGGESTION, not a rule: regional language from the location facts (read by the LLM, no hardcoded mapping); for 5 Cr+ sellers (trait.high_value) suggest English; the agent may change either with cited seller evidence
language_start.evidence_rule: a location fact (profile state or city, GST state, onboarding cities) or a language the seller spoke on a past call

size_suggestion.5 Cr+ (high): suggest ENGLISH as the starting language (with light Hindi); a suggestion only: seller evidence (their location or the language they spoke) can change it, with cites
size_suggestion.other bands: suggest the regional language of the seller's location, from the LLM's reading of the location facts; never a fixed mapping

code_mix.looks_for: how much Hinglish or English the seller used in past calls
code_mix.evidence_rule: a past call where the seller spoke or asked for a particular language mix

formality.looks_for: business size, order values, contact designation
formality.evidence_rule: a contact designation (A04), a turnover band (C02), a high order value (E10), or a seller who addresses the caller formally

sophistication.looks_for: turnover band, order values, how technical the seller's own words were
sophistication.evidence_rule: turnover band, nature of business, order values, or how technical or simple the seller's own words were

warmth.looks_for: complaints, frustration, tone of past calls
warmth.evidence_rule: an open complaint (I01), a frustrated call turn (needs more warmth), or a friendly call turn

empathy.looks_for: open complaint, frustration, earlier calls to acknowledge
empathy.evidence_rule: an open complaint (I01) or a past call where the seller described a bad earlier experience

words_per_turn.looks_for: how long the seller's past answers were; whether past calls were cut short
words_per_turn.evidence_rule: past call turns showing the seller cuts the caller short (shorter replies) or asks for detail (longer replies)

hook.looks_for: money lead, profile gap, unused credits, lead quality, grievance, peer usage, category demand
hook.note: OPEN QUESTION: use the same hierarchy for a per-segment hook brief? Hooks are not logged in the learning step at a8f2e06.
hook.probe_files: see top-level 'hooks' (each hook has its own probe_files and search_terms)
hook.evidence_rule: the hook's own facts (facts.py eligibility) plus its probe sections; money first

opening.looks_for: past calls and the hook facts; short, one value statement then one simple question
opening.hard_range: validator wording rules (banned words, gender agreement, identity line)
opening.evidence_rule: a past call that the opening should acknowledge or avoid repeating

records_per_call: per field: final value group, reason_type, outcome
learning.counts: per field x value group x level
reports: meeting rate by reason_type (seller_evidence, hierarchy, start_persona)
uplift vs P0 holdout (needs real calls)
learning.card_changes: the script suggests; a human approves a new persona_library.json version
learning.test_calls: go to data/scoreboards_test, never to data/scoreboards

tests_required: hierarchy used with an unread probe file fails
hierarchy used with no searched note fails
seller evidence available but hierarchy used, with no explanation, fails
start_persona without a searched note fails
a value outside its hard range fails
the keys loop2 writes equal the keys prior reads, both from this file

hook.money_lead.evidence_rule: a live or expired lead with an order value near the seller's AOV

hook.profile_gap.evidence_rule: products without photo or price, a weak catalogue score, or a thin profile

hook.category_demand.evidence_rule: local or total buy-lead counts in the seller's category

hook.unused_credits.evidence_rule: lapsed or unused buy-lead credits, or a call about credits

hook.lead_quality_fix.evidence_rule: rejected leads or call talk that leads are bad

hook.enquiry_drop.evidence_rule: enquiries falling versus the last quarter, or a seller saying enquiries stopped

hook.peer_usage.evidence_rule: an allowed peer rung (at least 5 same-size peers who bought)

hook.resolve_grievance.evidence_rule: an open complaint or a grievance in a call in the last 60 days

probe_rules.format: every probe_files entry is 'file#section' (a ### heading id in the folder file) or 'calls/' for the call files
probe_rules.calls: 'calls/' = every call file in the last 90 days that INDEX.md lists
probe_rules.search_terms: entries are literals or regexes: a 're:' prefix means regex (case-insensitive); otherwise a literal. ASCII literals match on WHOLE WORDS; non-ASCII (Hindi and other scripts) literals match as substrings. Prefer phrases over single words; no term that hits most call files (ji, haan, ok, meeting, called). Target: at most 10 hit lines per field on average over the 10 demo sellers.
probe_rules.evidence_rule: one line: what counts as evidence for the field

voice_lean_f.when: tense call, rural proxy, or Hindi belt and rural (extra female lean on top of the learned keys)

brief.rule: For each learned field the brief uses the DEEPEST level of the seller's path whose cell holds at least min_calls calls for that field (L6 is checked before L5, then L5 down to L0). level_used is null and value_groups is empty when no level has enough calls. Each group shows n calls and meeting rate (null when n is 0).
